Lessons.Title: The Numbers in Subtraction
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will recognize that a fraction can be subtracted from a whole number by writing an equivalent fraction for the whole number.
Key idea: A whole number can be decomposed into fractional units to subtract a fraction or mixed number.
How to reason: Rename the whole number using denominator-sized parts and subtract exact fractional pieces.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Number Talk: Groups of Twelfths (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1: What’s Left? (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as A pitcher contains 3 cups of watermelon juice., \(\frac{1}{4}\), \(\frac{5}{4}\), \(1\frac{1}{4}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: Card Sort: Twelfths (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(1 - \frac{5}{8}\), \(2 - \frac{7}{8}\), \(3 - \frac{9}{8}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
Edulytics worked model: Subtract 5/4 from 3.. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
Open reflection: Original juice pitcher context and sorted fraction card expressions stay teacher led.
